_doc: Hardware and model constants for ceiling.py / events_summary.py. Every number names its source. Update the source when you change a number; recompute the byte counts from the served GGUFs when a quant changes (gguf.GGUFReader). A lane's optional 'chain' lists its dispatches per step with dependent memory round trips and serial issue cycles per dispatch (ceiling.py's latency-chain term; per-value sources in each item).

hardware.name: Strix Halo, Radeon 8060S, gfx1151 (40 CUs, LPDDR5X unified)
hardware._src: 216 GB/s device copy (LEDGER standing-goal table); 228 GB/s reached by the decode matvecs (E50); ~45 TFLOP/s f16 WMMA clock-adjusted peak (E61)

model.name: Qwen3.8-27B UD3.1 UD-Q4_K_XL, KV8 v2, DFlash2 d7
model._src: make_lanes.py on Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf: decode = all matrices but the token embedding; gemm = the same without the head, every expert, loops once; linear_params = matrix elements per token without the head; kv = kv8; attention layers [3, 7, 11]...[59, 63]; MTP layers [64] excluded (not read when serving without MTP); restricted to the 851 tensors llm.loom references

lanes._src: g_head_mv_t*_q8 = @llm_verify on the target Q6_K head (1.043 GB)

chain._src: 16 per verify step (1,536 at [8,4,64] + 16 at [1,4,64] over 97 steps, W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)); trips: the page walk record -> per-row page map -> slot, then K/V, one dependent chain per key tile (E139); tiles are independent of each other (a kernel can prefetch the next tile's walk), so one walk per dispatch is what the design forces. serial_cycles unknown: the online-softmax carry across a split's ~40 key tiles is a true serial chain, but its per-tile instruction count was read before HEADPACK (E168: ~1,250 per tile, live pkg-u60kv2) and not since

16 per step (W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)); trips 1: any dispatch that reads its input pays one round trip (lower bound)

16 per step (W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)); reads the splits' partials: one round trip

lanes._src: g_head_mv_*_p40 = @llm_dflash_propose on the q4_0 proposal-head copy (pkg-u60kv2 llm.loom:146291); decode-phase GEMMs are the drafter's (per-step warm pass: g_gemm_q4_k_store/q6_k_store; the target decodes with matvecs)
lanes._src_submission: E163: the drafter's propose pass (opens with g_dfl_prepare, 131 dispatches) and its per-step warm pass (g_dfl_kv_store + the fc / K/V GEMMs, 21 dispatches) are submissions of their own; neither marker ever shares a submission with target attention (abba-u60x run 2: 95 + 117 submissions, none with vsplit or flash2). By name the lanes swapped call sites: the propose pass's g_mv_q4_k_* went to the target matvecs and the target's Q8_0 matvecs (ssm_alpha/beta, attn_k/v, attn_output, ssm_out) to the drafter

chain._src: 15,119 dispatches over 97 verify steps (W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)); trips 1 each (lower bound; matvec weight loads do not depend on each other). E367's laggards (q4_k K25600 at 147 GB/s, small grids at 64-256 workgroups 164-200 GB/s) are fill shortfalls (too few bytes in flight: Little's law, bandwidth x latency), not a dependent chain: they need the trip latency too and are not modelled here

4,608 over 97 steps (W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)); trips 1: the state is loaded once, the per-token q / k / v loads do not depend on it; serial_cycles: the recurrence carries the state from token to token, 8 verified tokens x the 335-instruction step loop (E185, E363), at most one instruction issued per wave per cycle (E344's issue rate): 2,680 cycles. This loop's count, not the algorithm's: E363 finds about a quarter of it is the state update, so a lever that shortens the loop lowers this term

chain.what: other GDN kernels (conv_commit, conv_bank, qk_norm, norm_gate, fold, fold_hist)
chain._src: the lane's 23,472 dispatches / 97 steps = 242.0 per step (W/static-1123/abba-e343 (summary.md, 3-e343/events.jsonl: pkg-e343 = HEADPACK, the limits table's verify attention, E350; 97 verify steps at 81,432)), minus the recurrence's 47.5; trips 1 each (lower bound)

lanes.lane: prefill: weight dequant to f16 scratch
lanes.note: design floor; ideal 0 (GEMM on quantized weights)

lanes._src_submission: E163: a prefill chunk's warm pass is its own submission (g_dfl_kv_store + the q4_k/q6_k m256 GEMMs); g_mv_q8_0 in flash2 epochs is the target's (ssm_alpha/beta)

_prefill_marker_src: a submission is prefill when it runs g_attention_flash2 OR its g_token_info covers more than prefill_min_tokens tokens (decode/verify epochs: <= 8 per row). Neither kernel name alone works: the DFlash warm pass runs GEMMs in its own submission both per verify step (8 tokens) and per prefill chunk (4096 tokens), without flash2 (11-21: ^g_gemm_ filed 97 per-step warm passes as prefill; ^g_attention_flash2 alone filed 20 chunk warm passes, 4096-row GEMMs, as decode)
